Speaking at India’s Industrial Transformation event, Chief Economic Advisor (CEA) V. Anantha Nageswaran highlighted that the last six years have witnessed persistent economic shocks sharing a common denominator: supply-side disruptions. Highlighting critical vulnerabilities, the CEA pointed to semiconductor chip shortages, tariff-linked trade retaliations, and heavy reliance on crude oil as key examples shaping current economic challenges.
Thank you for watching our video!
